model.title: Stop Pills That Kill Act
model.meta: Energy and Commerce Committee, Judiciary Committee · Rep. Gabe Evans (R-CO)

summary.text: The bill would increase criminal penalties for possessing, manufacturing, or distributing equipment or materials used to illegally make fentanyl or counterfeit drugs. It would also require the Drug Enforcement Administration to develop a plan to combat counterfeit fentanyl and methamphetamine through law enforcement and prevention efforts, and require the Department of Justice to annually report on how much counterfeit fentanyl and methamphetamine law enforcement seizes and how many related prosecutions occur.
